note: Crook County, WY: no queryable zoning district service found. Sundance publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (media/831). The county planning page links only a property ownership map viewer with no zoning layer. The statewide Wyoming Interactive Zoning Web App's FeatureServer (services6.arcgis.com/CWUB5LdQqLSWLhLO, layer 3 Current Zoning Parcels) holds no Crook County parcels; its records are Minnesota (Chisago/Forest Lake). The county's Oregon-based Planning Zones dataset is a different county. The county GIS server gis.crookcounty.wy.gov (Assessor_Data) lists no zoning layer and was unreachable.
